profile.headline: Web Developer at Cornell Custom Development
profile.summary:
I'm a web programmer living in Ithaca, NY. My goals include working closely with a team to achieve beautiful, functional websites; creating high-quality code that is easy for others to understand and maintain; improving the world around me by providing sites and services that can help people; and consistently learning and growing as a developer.

Outside of work, you can find me going on weekend cycling and camping trips, playing board games with friends, or hanging out at home with my cat, Sterling.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Ithaca, New York, United States · Remote

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Build and theme WordPress sites, with a focus on accessibility standards, user interface design, and ease of use for content creators. Maintain existing WordPress and Drupal websites for security, accessibility, and changing best practices. Assist with project planning, internal graphic design and social media requirements, and video recording projects.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Created Drupal themes and custom modules; built and maintained custom web apps in Ruby on Rails.
Interfaced with clients to ensure their satisfaction with final products. Completed project discoveries, wireframed and designed new projects, and wrote technical blog posts and case studies.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for Doug Turnbull, Associate Professor of Computer Science
positions.description: Assisted students in Introduction to Website Development during class time; troubleshooted HTML and CSS issues that students faced. Supported Professor Turnbull in teaching web design elements such as the creation of UI Mockups and the use of photo manipulation software such as GIMP or Photoshop.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for Dr. Dennis Charsky, Communication Management & Design Program Director
positions.description: Worked with students in Presentation Media and Visual Design class during class time to answer questions about Photoshop, Powerpoint, and other software; solved presentation and media issues related to class assignments. Assisted Dr. Charsky outside of class with maintaining website for the Communication Management and Design major; including updating and organizing Alumni profiles and writing news stories about CMD students and alumni.

positions.title: Student Manager, Digital Media Services
positions.description: Acted as liaison between fellow student staff members and Digital Media Services area supervisor; trained new DMS student employees and answered any questions that arose during day to day activities. Worked with other student managers and Student Staff Coordinator in the hiring and training processes each semester, and planned events for student and full-time staff members. Created promotional materials for events, training materials such as guides and training games, and t-shirt designs.
